full_judgment:
This appeal is directed against the judgment and decree passed by Mr. R. K. Biswas District Judge, Kushtia in Title Appeal No. 61 of 1971 reversing those of Mr. A.H. Sirdar, Munsif passed in O.C. suit No. 488 of 1970. 

 3. The defendant contested the suit and contended that the plaintiff was found guilty of a charge of misappropriation of money and so he was dismissed by the Manager on consideration of the report of the enquiry committee. That he was dismissed by the Manager and the order of dismissal was legal and valid. The learned Munsif on consideration of the materials on record dismissed the suit. On appeal the appellate Court below allowed the appeal and decreed the suit.
